elements.name: Open and cancel the first save

steps.name: a new unsaved part is active in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S
a Save As dialog opens
a proposed document name is selected in the file name field
a location, file type and preview options are displayed
the user cancels the dialog
the Save As dialog closes
the unsaved part remains active
the user presses Control+S again in the same session
the Save As dialog reopens with the same proposed document name selected
the user cancels the dialog again
the unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Save and reopen a newly created empty part

steps.name: a new unsaved empty part is active in the MCAD Software
the proposed file name does not already exist in the selected folder
the user presses Control+S
the user accepts the proposed file name in the Save As dialog
the dialog closes
the active document tab displays the saved file name
the model browser root displays the saved file name
the user closes that document tab
the user opens the saved file from the same folder
the saved part becomes active
its viewport contains no visible model geometry
its model browser displays the origin and end-of-part marker

elements.name: Save changes to an existing part and reopen its sketch

steps.name: a saved empty part is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates a planar sketch with a rectangular profile
the user finishes the sketch
the user presses Control+S
the existing document remains open without a Save As dialog
the user closes the document tab
the user opens the file-opening dialog in the same session
the user selects the saved part
the user opens the selected part
the model browser contains the sketch
the rectangular sketch profile is visible in the viewport

elements.name: Toggle the preview picture controls before saving

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
Save Preview Picture is selected
the user clears Save Preview Picture
the preview source choices are hidden
the preview area displays a placeholder
the user selects Save Preview Picture again
the preview source choices reappear
the user chooses Active Window on Save
that preview source is selected
Active Component Iso View on Save is not selected
the user chooses Active Component Iso View on Save
the user cancels the dialog
the unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Browse for a preview image and cancel the image chooser

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
Save Preview Picture is selected
the user chooses Import From File as the preview source
a browse control appears beside that option
the preview area displays a placeholder
the user chooses the browse control
an image file chooser opens above the Save As dialog
the user cancels the image file chooser
the Save As dialog remains open
Import From File remains selected
the preview area still displays a placeholder
the user chooses Active Component Iso View on Save
the user cancels Save As
the unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Inspect file type choices when saving a part

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the user opens the file type list
the list offers the native part file type and an All Files filter

elements.name: Cancel closing a modified unsaved part

steps.name: an unsaved part containing a finished empty sketch is active in the MCAD Software
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the user closes the document tab
a save-changes prompt offers Yes, No and Cancel
the user chooses Cancel
the part remains active
its sketch remains in the model browser

elements.name: Cancel the first save requested while closing a part

steps.name: an unsaved part containing a finished empty sketch is active in the MCAD Software
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the user closes the document tab
the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt
the Save As dialog opens
the user cancels Save As
the part remains active
its sketch remains in the model browser

elements.name: Inspect save-change prompt frequency choices

steps.name: an unsaved modified part is active in the MCAD Software
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the user closes the document tab
the user opens the prompt-frequency list
the list offers always show, once per operation, suppress for this session and suppress permanently
the user dismisses the list without changing its selection
the user cancels the save-changes prompt
the part remains active

elements.name: Save a new modified part while closing it

steps.name: an unsaved part containing a finished empty sketch is active in the MCAD Software
save-change prompts are configured to always show
another document is open
the proposed file name does not exist in the selected folder
the user closes the document tab
the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt
the user accepts the proposed file name in Save As
the document closes
another open document becomes active
the user reopens the newly saved part in the same session
the part becomes active
its model browser contains the finished sketch

elements.name: Capture an active window preview before saving

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new empty part in the MCAD Software
Save Preview Picture is selected
the user chooses Active Window as the preview source
a capture control appears beside Active Window
the preview area displays a placeholder
the user activates the capture control
the preview area displays a dark image matching the empty workspace
the Save As dialog remains open
the user cancels the dialog
the unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Select an existing part in the first-save dialog

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the current folder contains an existing part file
the user selects that part file in the file list
the selected file row is highlighted
the file name field displays the selected file's name
the status area reports one selected item
the user cancels the dialog
the unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Navigate to a subfolder and back while choosing a save location

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the initial folder contains a subfolder
the dialog displays a proposed file name
the user opens the subfolder
the location breadcrumb and file list show the subfolder
the proposed file name remains in the file name field
the user chooses Back
the initial folder and its file list are displayed
the proposed file name remains in the file name field

elements.name: Reopen first save after cancelling in a subfolder

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the user has navigated from the initial folder into a subfolder
the user cancels the dialog
the user presses Control+S again for the same part
the Save As dialog opens in the initial folder
the original proposed file name is selected

elements.name: Cancel disabling the preview picture

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
Save Preview Picture is selected
the user clears Save Preview Picture
the user cancels the dialog
the user presses Control+S again for the same part
Save Preview Picture is selected
the preview source choices are displayed

elements.name: Cancel a change to the preview source

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
Save Preview Picture is selected
Active Component Iso View on Save is selected
the user chooses Active Window on Save
the user cancels the dialog
the user presses Control+S again for the same part
Active Component Iso View on Save is selected
Active Window on Save is not selected

elements.name: Switch save-dialog navigation modes

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the navigation pane shows libraries and recent folders
the dialog displays a current folder and proposed file name
the user switches to system-location navigation
the navigation pane displays system locations and drives
the current folder and proposed file name remain displayed
the preview settings remain displayed
the user switches back to recent-folder navigation
the navigation pane displays libraries and recent folders
the current folder and proposed file name remain displayed
the user cancels Save As
the unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Reopen Save As after switching navigation mode

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the navigation pane shows libraries and recent folders
the user switches to system-location navigation
the user cancels Save As
the user opens Save As again for the same part
the navigation pane shows libraries and recent folders
the proposed file name is selected
the user cancels Save As
the unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Change the file-list presentation in Save As

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the current folder contains part files and subfolders
the file list is displayed in Details view
a proposed file name is displayed
the user activates the file-list view control
the file list displays thumbnail tiles with names and file information
the proposed file name and preview settings remain displayed
the user chooses the Details view shortcut
the file list displays rows with name, modification date, type and size columns
the proposed file name remains displayed
the user cancels Save As
the unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Decline replacing an existing part during first save

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the current folder contains an existing part file
the user selects the existing part file
the user chooses Save
a confirmation identifies the existing file and asks whether to replace it
the confirmation offers Yes and No
the Save As dialog remains behind the confirmation
the user chooses No
the confirmation closes
Save As remains open with the existing file name displayed
the user cancels Save As
the new unsaved part remains active

elements.name: Inspect Save As commands for a saved part

steps.name: a saved part is active in the MCAD Software
the user opens the application menu
the user expands Save As
the menu offers Save As and Save Copy As
it offers Save Copy As Template and Pack and Go
the Save Copy As description says the original file remains open

elements.name: Inspect the first-save preview of a solid part

steps.name: an unsaved part containing a visible rectangular solid is active in the MCAD Software
the first-save preview settings are configured to save an isometric component view
the user presses Control+S
the Save As dialog opens with a proposed part filename selected
Save Preview Picture is checked
Active Component Iso View on Save is selected
the preview area displays a shaded isometric block

elements.name: Retain a selected file name after changing the file-list selection

steps.name: the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the current folder contains a part file and a subfolder
the user selects the part file in the file list
the file is highlighted and its name appears in the file name field
the user selects the subfolder with a single click
the subfolder is highlighted without opening
the file name field still displays the selected part file name
the user clicks empty space in the file list
no file or folder is highlighted
the file name field still displays the part file name
the user cancels Save As
the new unsaved part remains active
